description: This file defines a PHP class 'Recent' that extends the OpenCart Controller class. It manages the dashboard's recent activities, including rendering the recent items form, saving configuration settings via AJAX, and providing dashboard data. The class includes methods for rendering a view, saving settings, and constructing the dashboard's HTML content.

classes.name: Recent
classes.description: A controller class for managing the recent dashboard widget in the admin panel, including rendering the form, saving settings via AJAX, and providing data for the dashboard display.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the recent dashboard configuration form in the admin panel.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to save the recent dashboard settings, including permission checks and storing settings in the database.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Generates and returns HTML content for the recent dashboard widget, including latest orders and configuration data.
